data.name: CRM_001
data.value: These stones have stayed still for centuries...[pause=15] so why do I feel like they're watching?

data.name: CRM_002
data.value: (The stone here isn't dead.[pause=15] It remembers.)

data.name: CRM_003
data.value: The ancient ones arise.[pause=20] What time froze still,[pause=10] the ruin has rekindled.

data.name: CRM_004
data.value: A Claydol![pause=15] It just lit up,[pause=10] and it's spotted us!

data.name: CRM_005
data.value: And that colossus...[pause=15] A Golurk![pause=10] They guard the way through!

data.name: CRM_006
data.value: HALT.[pause=15] Sanctuary sealed.[pause=15] No living being crosses this post.

data.name: CRM_008
data.value: They're following an old directive...[pause=15] but we HAVE to pass![pause=10] {0},[pause=10] let's go!

data.name: CRM_009
data.value: The sentinels have lit up again.[pause=15] This time we pass!

data.name: CRM_010
data.value: DIRECTIVE FULFILLED.[pause=20] The living have earned their passage.

data.name: CRM_012
data.value: They went dark...[pause=15] As if they had only been waiting for stronger guardians.

data.name: CRM_013
data.value: (Centuries of watching in the dark.[pause=15] Maybe we just set them free.)

data.name: CRM_014
data.value: INTRUDERS REPELLED.[pause=15] The post shall remain sealed.

data.name: CRM_015
data.value: Stone yields only to perseverance.[pause=20] Return stronger.
